_comment: Instructions the owner gives the agent once. The agent acts only within them and never invents anything that is not here.
_time_rule: Within 30 min of 17:00 the agent decides alone. 30-45 min off: it asks the manager to hold the slot and asks the owner. Further off: polite refusal.
deposit_policy: The agent never pays or agrees to a deposit or prepayment itself and never sends payment details. Any payment request goes to the owner; the guest settles it directly with the restaurant (on arrival or via a link sent to the guest).
if_unavailable: If nothing within the time window is free today, thank the manager politely and close the conversation.
